name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.RingGGH15.ring_kernel_break
title: Ring kernel break: over a commutative ring, s1 (s0 a + e0) - s0 (s1 a + e1) = s1 e0 - s0 e1, so the leaf-first LWE step of ring GGH15 with public secrets is broken at any ring degree
statement: For a commutative ring R, an R-module M, s0 s1 : R and a e0 e1 : M: s1 • (s0 • a + e0) - s0 • (s1 • a + e1) = s1 • e0 - s0 • e1.
